assessments.name: Research Paper Viva
assessments.description: Group viva but assessed individually; this assessment is designed as an introduction to tissue engineering through structured engagement with seminal research papers.

assessments.name: Oxygen Diffusion Simulation
assessments.description: This assessment is designed to develop students’ ability to apply engineering reasoning, modelling, and simulation to a biologically relevant tissue engineering problem.

assessments.name: Shark Tank Draft
assessments.description: A formative milestone to confirm your group is progressing in the right direction before the live pitch and final report.

assessments.name: In-class End of Sem Quiz
assessments.description: The in‑class quiz is designed to provide an integrative conclusion to the unit, allowing students to demonstrate their consolidated understanding of tissue engineering concepts developed across the semester.

assessments.name: Shark Tank; Group presentation
assessments.description: A Shark Tank–style pitch delivered to a panel of tutors

assessments.name: Report for Shark Tank
assessments.description: A technical, evidence-based written justification of your proposed tissue engineering solution.

assessments.name: Weekly Quizzes
assessments.description: The weekly online quizzes are designed to support ongoing engagement and knowledge reinforcement by encouraging students to regularly recall key concepts covered each week.

assessments.name: Pre-Lecture Questions
assessments.description: Students devise questions for the lecturer prior to the lecture session on Thursday, to prime for engagement. Due 11:59pm Wednesday the day before the Lecture session
